title: Announcing the Agent2Agent Protocol (A2A)
attributed_claim_summary: Google proposed A2A to enable collaboration between agents built using different platforms.
evidence_or_event: Source-authored report or launch; no original measurements collected in this repository.
limitations: Proposed interoperability and partner participation are not evidence of reliable field operation.
research_relevance: AI-era coding workflow -> secure functionality -> independent reuse -> lifetime cost; distinguish release availability from observed adoption.
practical_experiment: Define portable agent task contracts and evaluate interoperability with independent conformance tests.
